titulo: What Is AI, Really? It's Just a File of Numbers
descripcion:
There's no rulebook inside an AI. Just a file of 405 billion numbers that predicts one word-piece at a time. Here's what's really happening when a chatbot answers you: tokens, next-token prediction, training on 15 trillion tokens, why it runs on GPUs, why it doesn't remember you, and why it makes things up.
